# optimizelycmp_template (Data Source)

Looks up one template by title. It fails if there is no match or more than one.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `title` (String) Template title (case-insensitive exact match).

### Read-Only

- `applicable_to` (List of String)
- `description` (String)
- `id` (String) ID of the template.
- `is_active` (Boolean)
